reports.title: Garrett Motion Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results and Announces $250 Million Share Repurchase Program for 2027

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: Garrett is providing the following outlook for the full year 2026 for certain GAAP and non-GAAP financial measures.

Full Year 2026 Outlook | Prior Outlook
Net sales (GAAP) | $3.75 billion to $3.85 billion | $3.7 billion to $3.9 billion
Net sales growth at constant currency (Non-GAAP)* | +2% to +6% | +1% to +7%
Net income (GAAP) | $337 million to $352 million | $330 million to $360 million
Adjusted EBIT (Non-GAAP)* | $570 million to $590 million | $560 million to $600 million
Net cash provided by operating activities (GAAP) | $460 million to $500 million | $435 million to $525 million
Adjusted free cash flow (Non-GAAP)* | $410 million to $450 million | $385 million to $475 million
